rv.q: What it mainly provides is the opportunity to see such film and television stars as Calista Flockhart, Christian Slater, and Cooper Hoffman in the flesh. Unfortunately, they’re all upstaged by Lois, an adorable sheep whose program bio inform us that she appears annually in the Radio City Music Hall’s Christmas show.

The only thing that all these plays bring to mind is that nobody was happy. Nobody was happy and they were taking pleasure in making certain that they did their best to curtail any jocularity that might cross the threshold. The only good news was bad news.
